dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.sub: Share spare subscription capacity, or consume the market — settled in USDT.
dashboard.signInPrompt: Sign in to see your balance, selling and buying status.
dashboard.sellDesc: Per-account sell switches and today's usage.
dashboard.buyDesc: Which local tools route through Asale, and what they may buy.
dashboard.daemonDown: Cannot reach the Asale service (asaled). Make sure it is running, then reload.

daemonDown.label: Service down
daemonDown.desc: The local Asale service (asaled) is not responding.
daemonDown.hint: Start asaled — the client reconnects to it on its own.

signedOut.label: Signed out
signedOut.desc: Not signed in, so this device cannot join the market.
signedOut.hint: Sign in from the account card at the bottom of the sidebar.

connecting.label: Connecting
connecting.desc: Registering this device and opening the gateway session.
connecting.hint: This normally takes a few seconds.

reconnecting.label: Reconnecting
reconnecting.desc: The gateway link dropped and is being retried with backoff.
reconnecting.hint: Nothing is lost — selling resumes by itself once the link is back.

online.label: Connected
online.desc: Online and accepting relayed requests from the market.
online.hint: Sell limits and per-model lanes are managed on the Sell page.

onlineIdle.label: Online · idle
onlineIdle.desc: Connected, but no model lane of your selling accounts can serve right now.
onlineIdle.hint: Open Sell to see whether lanes are cooling, exhausted or paused.

throttled.label: Throttled
throttled.desc: The gateway is limiting how much traffic this device receives.
throttled.hint: Usually temporary — it clears without any action.

kicked.label: Dropped by server
kicked.desc: The gateway took this device off the market.
kicked.hint: Asale retries every minute; check the Sell page if it keeps happening.

pending.label: Starting
pending.desc: Accounts are switched on for selling; the market session is coming up.
pending.hint: If it stays here, check that you are signed in and online.

buyOnly.label: Buying only
buyOnly.desc: No account is selling. Buying runs through the local proxy.
buyOnly.hint: Switch an account on in Sell to start earning.

idle.label: Idle
idle.desc: This device is neither selling nor buying right now.
idle.hint: Switch an account on in Sell, or a tool on in Buy.

publish.title: Sell
publish.sub: Each connected subscription account has its own sell switch and daily limit.
publish.connectDesc: OAuth login opens your browser. Tokens are stored in your OS keychain — never uploaded.
publish.accountsDesc: Every connected account is listed separately. Switch on the ones you want to sell and give each its own daily cap — the others are never used for market traffic.
publish.accountsEmpty: No accounts yet — connect via OAuth above or import from an installed CLI below.
publish.cliNone: No CLI credentials found on this machine.
publish.envWarning: Warning: {{vars}} is set in the environment and overrides the CLI's stored credentials.
publish.limitUnlimited: No limit — capped only by the plan
publish.cliRescanHint: Re-scan this machine's CLI credentials and import them (already done once at startup)
publish.sharedHint: This credential was imported from a CLI installed on this machine, so both use the same upstream login.
publish.ownedHint: Asale signed in to this account itself and keeps its own credential copy.
publish.mergedHint: These local stores hold the token of the same subscription account, so they count as one sellable record.
publish.laneResumeHint: Put this model back on the market once you have fixed the problem

consume.title: Buy
consume.sub: Point the AI CLIs on this machine at Asale and choose which models to buy.
consume.codexNeedsModel: Codex picks its model from a list of its own, not from the request: with nothing selected it stays on its built-in GPT models, which the market cannot serve. Pick one and it is written into ~/.codex/config.toml and shows up in the ChatGPT app's model menu.
consume.toolsDesc: Each tool installed here gets its own buy switch. Turning it on rewrites that tool's config to route through Asale and backs up the original; turning it off restores the original exactly.
consume.restartNeeded: Written to disk, but {{tool}} only reads its config at startup: restart the {{tool}} app or terminal window for the change to take effect.
consume.drifted: The switch is on but {{path}} no longer points at Asale — something else changed it. Toggle off and on to re-apply.
consume.restartHint: Flipping a switch or changing the models takes effect only after the tool's app or terminal window is restarted — sessions already running are unaffected.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.sub: Off-chain USDT custodied by the Asale server, settled on TRON.
wallet.withdrawOk: Withdrawal #{{id}} submitted — pending review and broadcast.
wallet.invalidAddress: Invalid TRON address (must be T followed by 33 base58 characters).
wallet.invalidAmount: Amount must be greater than 0 and at most your available balance.
wallet.trc20Only: Check the network is TRON (TRC20) before you send.
wallet.depositWarnDesc: Send USDT over the TRON (TRC20) network. Other coins or networks (ERC20 / BEP20) will not arrive.
wallet.depositFeeNote: Every deposit is charged a {{fee}} USDT fee, taken out of the credited amount. Aim for at least {{min}} USDT per deposit — smaller ones are still credited, but the fee eats most of them.
wallet.addressHint: Double-check the address — on-chain transfers cannot be reversed.
wallet.whitelistOnly: Withdrawals are restricted to whitelisted addresses on this account.
wallet.histEmptyDesc: Anything you deposit or withdraw shows up here with its on-chain transaction.

records.title: Records
records.sub: Task records — the server ledger is authoritative; local metering is kept for reconciliation.
records.serverUnavailable: Server records unavailable ({{msg}}) — showing local records.
records.emptyProviderDesc: Requests you serve to the market will be listed here with their earnings.
records.emptyConsumerDesc: Requests your CLIs buy through Asale will be listed here with their cost.

usage.title: Usage
usage.sub: Token usage, model breakdown and daily detail by scope (My usage / Bought / Sold). "My usage" = all local AI-CLI sessions.
usage.noData: No data in the selected scope.

limits.title: Limits
limits.sub: Rate limits and quota usage across your AI tools.
limits.explainAheadEta: {{label}}: on pace to run out in ~{{eta}}
limits.explainAheadPct: {{label}}: on pace to hit {{pct}}% by reset
limits.explainAheadPctRemaining: {{label}}: on pace to {{pct}}% left by reset
limits.explainBody: The tick marks even-burn progress to now; fill past it means you're burning faster.
limits.explainBodyRemaining: The tick marks even-burn remaining to now; fill below it means you're burning faster.
limits.sellDesc: Cap how many tokens each subscription sells per day (auto-stops at the limit). Set by token count or as a percentage of the subscription's daily cap.
limits.note: Limits track locally-metered sold usage and reset each UTC day. The "subscription daily cap" is the plan's 5h-window cap scaled to a full-day equivalent (×4.8) and is a reference figure only.
limits.estimateUnsupported: This provider exposes no live limits endpoint; the bars below estimate from what this device has served.
limits.estimateFailed: Could not read the provider's live limits; the bars below estimate from what this device has served.

account.title: Account
account.subSignedOut: Sign in to sync your wallet and manage API keys.
account.regionHint: Used for market distribution and regional settlement rules; you can change it later in your profile.
account.runInside: Run inside the desktop app to sign in.

center.title: Account center
center.subtitle: Manage your profile, sign-in methods and interface preferences.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Display name
profile.nameDesc: The name shown for you across Asale.
profile.avatarUrlDesc: Link to the image used as your avatar.
profile.regionDesc: Country code used for market distribution and settlement.

security.title: Security
security.setPasswordHint: You signed up with a linked account — set a password to also sign in with email.
security.changePasswordDesc: Use a strong password of at least 8 characters.
security.connectedAccountsDesc: Link Google or GitHub to sign in with one click.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.desc: Language and appearance — this machine only.

apiKey.title: Buyer API key
apiKey.desc: Generated automatically after sign-in and cached locally; the proxy uses it automatically. Regenerate if you need to.
apiKey.confirmWarning: Regenerating revokes the current key immediately. Tools that are buying get the new one written into their config automatically, but must be restarted to pick it up.
apiKey.regenerated: A new API key has been generated.
apiKey.refreshed: A new API key has been generated and written into {{tools}}. Restart those tools so they pick it up.

account.verifySentSubtitle: We sent a verification link to {{email}}.
account.verifySentHint: Click the link in that email to finish creating your account, then sign in here. The link expires in 24 hours. If it hasn't arrived in a few minutes, check your spam folder or send a new one.
account.verifyResent: A new verification link is on its way.
account.verifySendFailed: Your account was created, but the verification email could not be sent. Please request a new link.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: App behavior: launch at login, updates. Closing the window hides Asale to the system tray.
settings.autostartDesc: Start Asale automatically when you sign in to your computer — recommended if you sell tokens, so you stay online.
settings.updateDesc: Current version {{version}}. Updates are downloaded from the Asale release endpoint and verified against the build signature.
settings.daemonDesc: The local daemon that runs all native and server logic. The desktop shell and browsers are both frontends over it.
settings.shellOnlyNote: Auto-start and in-app updates are provided by the desktop shell. In browser mode, manage the asaled service with your system tools (e.g. systemd).
settings.proxyDesc: The proxy Asale uses to reach the Claude / Codex / Gemini APIs. In some regions a direct connection is refused with a 403, which breaks token refresh and direct routing. This affects provider traffic only, not Asale's own communication.

proxyModeHint.auto: Reads https_proxy and friends first, then the OS proxy settings. A desktop launch usually inherits none of your terminal's variables, so the system setting is what applies.
proxyModeHint.off: Always connect directly, even when the environment or the OS names a proxy.
proxyModeHint.manual: Always use the address below, ignoring the environment and the OS.

settings.proxyUrlHint: http://, https:// or socks5:// — for example http://127.0.0.1:7890
settings.proxyTestOk: Reachable — the provider endpoint answered ({{ms}} ms)
settings.proxyTestBlocked: The endpoint refused the connection (403): providers are not reachable from this network. Configure a working proxy.
settings.proxyEnvOverride: The environment variable {{name}}={{value}} overrides this setting. Clear it and restart the Asale service to control the proxy from here.

modelPicker.title: Choose models
modelPicker.empty: No models to choose from yet.
